title: Derived tensor pullback with a fixed factor is natural in the other factor
statement: For a morphism g:Z -> Y of schemes [def-pc-scheme] and a commutative coefficient ring A, use the small etale derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. For each M in D(Y_et,A), there is a natural isomorphism between K |-> Lg^{-1}(K tensor^L M) and K |-> Lg^{-1}(K) tensor^L Lg^{-1}(M). Its component at K is the canonical source-library leftDerivedUpperStarTensorIso.

proof.text: Reuse the source construction derivedTensorRightCompLeftDerivedUpperStarIso in WeilConjectures/SixFunctors/Etale/Derived/UpperStarMonoidal/Comparison.lean, lines 146-151. It fixes the second variable of leftDerivedUpperStarTensorNatIso. That comparison derives the ordinary strong monoidal comparison on K-flat resolutions. The source proves it invertible using exactness of inverse image and resolutions whose inverse images are K-flat. Naturality is NatTrans.congr_app of the two-variable naturality identity.

noncomputable def derivedTensorRightCompLeftDerivedUpperStarIso
    (M : DerivedCategory (Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology A)) :
    derivedTensorRight A Y M ⋙ L((g)^*[A]) ≅
      L((g)^*[A]) ⋙ derivedTensorRight A Z (L((g)^*[A]).obj M)
